description: Implementation of CustomJobParameterRepository for database operations related to custom job parameters in Fineract, including saving and retrieving JSON-serialized parameters.

classes.name: CustomJobParameterRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Repository implementation for custom job parameters, handling database insert and select operations.

classes.name: CustomJobParameterExtractor
classes.description: ResultSetExtractor to convert SQL query result into CustomJobParameter object.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a set of JobParameterDTOs as JSON into the database and returns the generated primary key.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomJobParameter by its ID from the database.
